rules: NavigationCache is opt-in and belongs to one synchronous DOM-read analysis/classification/currentness batch only. No global cache, observer/frame cache or persistent semantic cache.
Create a fresh cache for every later card/menu/after-focus/currentness call. Standalone calls without a cache remain uncached.

Only fixed safe supplied labels, element identities, bounded direct list membership (at most 24), menu/breadcrumb booleans, unique-id lookups and visibility booleans are cached. No ancestor whole-region text, input value, checked state or editable subtree text is read.
Existing document source attributes/actions and currentness checks remain in sourceSnapshot. Cache optional parameter is appended after six existing parameters.
Context paragraph fallback first requires an actual direct p and the same at-most-three-controls condition. Its safe fixed label and visibility are recomputed in each fresh ContextCache.
Original RUN008 firstFAIL/freeze/source archives/evaluation records are unchanged. Existing 60 pages remain development-exposed; no new sample was opened.

api.analyzePage: Creates a fresh NavigationCache and ContextCache internally.
api.ContextCache: WeakMap<Element,ContextSummary>; callers creating new WeakMap() remain compatible; summary is analyzer-internal.
api.rootIntegration: Root owns classifier/page-session batch plumbing, including new caches per areCandidatesCurrent invocation and uncached/fresh standalone isCandidateCurrent. This worker did not edit those files.

diagnosis.directListEnumeration: Original directItems converted list.children to an array before checking <=24. At 1000 controls sharing a list, this enumerated 1000000 children. Child bound now precedes enumeration; cached negative summary avoids repeated structural work.
diagnosis.paragraphFallback: Original context fallback queried every a/button/input before checking whether a direct p existed. Flat1000 fixture returned1001000 matching controls. A direct p existence check and per-parent summary reduce these queries to0 for paragraph-free lists.
diagnosis.batchReuse: The same control utility and source snapshot now share final navigation result and avoid repeated visibility/layout checks inside an explicitly supplied batch.

focused.command: npx playwright test --config docs/evidence/run009/analyzer-performance/playwright.config.mjs tests/analysis-batch-performance.spec.mjs tests/navigation-utility.spec.mjs tests/analyzer-context.spec.mjs
focused.scope: 7 new operation/cache/privacy/stale tests,21 existing analyzer context tests,13 existing navigation utility tests; fresh isolated headless with no webServer.

validation.privateAccess: Poisoned input.value/input.checked/textarea.value/editable textContent/innerText/child nodeValue getters:0 reads in the focused test.
validation.nextBatchCurrentness: Same-frame equal-text target clone re-resolves to the new actual node; duplicate IDs reject; rel/href/onclick/target/aria-current/form move and original equal-markup clone reject stale candidates.
validation.batchLayout: 1 getClientRects call for source initial navigation result;20 navigationUtility+sourceSnapshot repetitions add0 calls; fresh batch adds a layout call.

limits: Wall timings in operations-before/after are diagnostic only while other workers were active. No p95/final 300ms pipeline acceptance claim is made.
Source-stable final sequential generic/institution pipeline/currentness/overlay benchmarks must be run by root after workers stop.
No full suite/core/live/native/install/VoiceOver/zoom/human-use/independent quality claims or commits were made.
A caller must not reuse NavigationCache across DOM writes or asynchronous boundaries. API documentation states this lifetime and root integration must preserve it.
